theme: Last day ashore before the charter
greeting: Your last full day ashore in Dubrovnik before the charter, Dan. Everything worth doing today is about getting off dry land clean -- cash, provisions, and the transfers you can't arrange once you're sailing.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat transfers before you board
needsAttention.detail: Three open items on the Cavtat hotel need arranging from dry land before Saturday: the ~noon Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer on Sept 19, an early bag hold, and a pre-5 AM checkout for your Sunday flight. Charter connectivity is poor once you're underway.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding and return transfer with Nautilus
needsAttention.detail: Message the instructor to pin down tomorrow's ~5 PM meeting time and location, and arrange the Sept 19 airport transfer now while you still have signal.

needsAttention.title: Provision in Dubrovnik before the 5 PM Saturday boarding
needsAttention.detail: Withdraw ~200 EUR in cash and grab snacks, alcohol, and any gluten-free non-perishables before you board -- Studenac, Tommy, or Konzum downtown.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the St Pete Airbnb converted
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27-Oct 5 St Pete booking was pending host acceptance; check it went to confirmed rather than expiring. The Sept 20-21 landing gap is still unbooked.

flagged.title: Synchrony statement ready
flagged.detail: Your Mattress Firm / Synchrony Home monthly statement is available to view online.

flagged.title: New governance and gov-affairs alerts
flagged.detail: LinkedIn flagged VP Government Affairs roles similar to one at Macy's.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and retail -- Chairish, Monocle, NYT Cooking, campaign asks, and travel promos.

recipe.title: Translucent Apple Tart
recipe.why: Orchard apples are hitting their autumn peak, ready for a tart that lets them shine.

tasks.title: Book the Sept 20-Oct 5 Tampa SUV rental outright
Book St Pete lodging for the Sept 20-21 landing gap

acts.line: An open day in Dubrovnik's Old Town -- no meetings, your last full one ashore.
Run the pre-boarding errands: cash, provisions, and the Cavtat transfer calls that need dry land.
Last night at the Old Port apartment; the Nautilus charter boards tomorrow at five.
